events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival for Peace and Music began on this day in 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in upstate New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, Woodstock brought together half a million people for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, leading to his death six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot on this day in 1996. His impact on hip-hop and music culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1970, we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire musicians worldwide.

events.title: Abbey Road Album Release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history – what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have made The Pretenders a timeless band. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: 'Imagine' Single Release
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released 'Imagine' in the UK. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your favourite 007 and which Bond theme song gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: 'The White Album' Release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from this double album is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
